about: Markup and the text a div holds after div.innerHTML = html, as its textContent reads it, one case per rule js/kernel/core/blocks/html-text.js lists: a div of the page's document, where scripting is on, or, where a case says "scripting": false, of an inert document (createHTMLDocument). test/kernel/blocks-html-text.test.mjs runs each through html-text.js, and e2e/block-projections.spec.js through Chromium, so the two agree on every case.

cases.rule: CR LF and CR become LF
CR LF before a pre's newline is one newline

spaces around = and attributes without values

nested templates
